battle.name: 富平之戰
battle.brief: 建炎四年九月，宋知樞密院事張浚集五路大軍十八萬人北伐關中，進抵富平。金將完顏婁室與兀術以兩翼騎兵合擊，宋軍潰退邠州，輜重盡棄。弓弩仍列陣前排，卻擋不住騎兵迂迴與糧道斷絕：弩機換來的射速，救不了一條已經斷掉的補給線。

kit.name: 十字弩
kit.history: 弩把射速交給了機械，代價是裝填慢。城牆上它比長弓可靠，野戰裡它比長弓脆弱。

countries: 富平之戰的交戰方是金朝與南宋，第三方是西夏。金太宗完顏晟在天會八年（宋高宗建炎四年）七月決定先取陝西，以解除南宋河東防區對金山西側翼的威脅：命右副元帥完顏宗輔代陝西都統完顏婁室為攻陝主帥，把原駐江南六合的四太子完顏宗弼（兀術）所部西調洛陽，另聽從左副元帥完顏宗翰之謀，在中原扶植宋降臣劉豫建立偽齊，令偽齊接管淮東、淮西、京西三個攻宋戰場，作為南線的緩衝。金軍的指揮體系分三路：完顏宗輔統軍攻陝，完顏婁室自河東率軍數萬，沿晉陽、韓城方向南下，進至綏德軍一線，擋住宋軍東進；兀術率二萬騎自洛陽西來，與婁室在富平會合；淮南監軍完顏昌仍率重兵駐於兩淮，隨時可以南下。金軍以女真騎兵為骨幹，兼用漢人、契丹、渤海降附部眾，攻城靠拋石、雲梯與穴地，野戰則以騎兵迂迴分割為主。南宋方面，由知樞密院事兼川陝宣撫處置使張浚統一節制：他自獻黃金萬兩、預借川陝五年民賦，用金錢糧食換取各路部隊的服從，集合永興軍路、環慶路、涇原路、秦鳳路、熙河路五個經略使轄下的兵馬，分別由吳玠、趙哲、劉錡、孫渥、劉錫領兵。戰後環慶路將領慕容洮叛降西夏，涇原路將領張中彥、李彥琪投降金軍，這是本戰役中唯一有明確第三方插足的部分。
countriesEn: The opposing sides at Fuping were the Jin dynasty and Southern Song, with Western Xia standing apart. Jin Taizong, Wanyan Sheng, in the eighth year of Tianhui, the fourth year of Jianyan under Song Gaozong, resolved in the seventh month to take Shaanxi first, in order to lift the pressure that the Song defences in Hedong exerted on Jin's western flank: he appointed the right deputy commander Wanyan Zongfu to replace the Shaanxi commander-in-chief Wanyan Loushi as overall commander of the Shaanxi offensive, and recalled Wanyan Zongbi, the Fourth Prince, known as Wuzhu, from Liuhe in Jiangnan to Luoyang, while on the advice of the left deputy commander Wanyan Zonghan he set up the state of Qi under the surrendered Song official Liu Yu in the Central Plains, ordering Qi to take over the three attack fronts of Huaidong, Huaixi and Jingxi as a buffer on the southern line. Jin's command ran along three axes: Wanyan Zongfu directed the assault on Shaanxi; Wanyan Loushi led several tens of thousands down from Hedong past Jinyang and Hancheng, reaching the line of Suide and barring the Song advance to the east; Wuzhu brought twenty thousand cavalry from Luoyang to join Loushi at Fuping, while the overseer in Huai-nan, Wanyan Chang, still held a heavy force between the two Huai rivers, free to march south at any moment. Jin's host was built on Jurchen cavalry, with Han Chinese, Khitan and former Bohai troops folded in; for siege work it used stone-throwers, scaling ladders and mining, while in the field it relied on cavalry manoeuvre and encirclement. On the Song side all was directed by Zhang Jun, Master of the Privy Council and Inspector-General of Sichuan and Shaanxi, who gave ten thousand taels of his own gold and borrowed the military revenues of the Sichuan-Shaanxi circuits for five years ahead, buying with silver and grain the obedience of the troops of the five circuits of Yongxing, Huanqing, Jingyuan, Qinfeng and Xihe, led respectively by Wu Jie, Zhao Zhe, Liu Qi, Sun Wo and Liu Xi. The only clearly recorded third-party intervention came after the fighting, when the Huanqing commander Murong Tao defected to Western Xia and the Jingyuan commanders Zhang Zhongyan and Li Yanqi surrendered to Jin.
people: 此役關鍵人物是南方的張浚與金方的完顏婁室、完顏宗輔、兀術。張浚是南宋初年的抗金名將，任川陝宣撫處置使，銳於抗金而短於用兵，急於轉守為攻；幕僚曲端建議按兵據險、待一二年後再圖反攻，張浚不納，並將曲端罷免。張浚自恃宿將資歷與兵多糧足，向金軍遞送戰書約日會戰，戰前甚至以送婦人之服的方式示辱金將，又榜示全軍：能生擒完顏婁室者授節度使、賞銀絹各以萬計；完顏婁室針鋒相對，懸賞能活捉張浚者賞驢一頭、布一匹。劉錫以熙河經略使兼五路軍都統制，主張乘婁室未到先攻兀術，並詐立已被罷免的曲端以張聲勢，此舉被婁室識破；吳玠建議移據高地以當金軍騎兵，劉錫等以我眾彼少、前有蘆葦阻騎為由不納，終致宋軍立營於低窪沼澤之旁。趙哲領環慶路軍，戰至黃昏孤軍不敵，擅自離陣，部眾遂潰。完顏婁室身有疾病仍督右軍力攻，親自登山觀陣，識破宋軍虛實；完顏宗輔以婁室為右翼、兀術為左翼總攬攻勢；驍將完顏折合以三千騎開路；宋將韓常被流矢射傷一目，仍奮力苦戰，與兀術一同破圍；金將赤盞暉所率騎兵陷於泥濘之中，被斬甚眾。
peopleEn: The decisive personalities were Zhang Jun on the Song side and Wanyan Loushi, Wanyan Zongfu and Wuzhu on the Jin side. Zhang Jun was a celebrated commander of the early Southern Song, serving as Inspector-General of Sichuan and Shaanxi: keen on resistance to Jin but weak in the art of command, and in a hurry to turn defence into attack. His adviser Qu Duan urged him to hold fast in defensible ground and to wait a year or two before counter-attacking; Zhang Jun refused and dismissed Qu Duan from his post. Relying on his reputation as a veteran and on the sight of abundant men and grain, Zhang Jun sent a letter of battle to the Jin army to fix a day for the engagement, and before the fight went so far as to send women's clothing to the Jin commanders as a taunt. He also posted a proclamation offering the rank of jiedushi and ten thousand each of silver and silk to whoever could capture Wanyan Loushi alive; Loushi answered in kind, offering a donkey and a bolt of cloth to whoever could take Zhang Jun alive. Liu Xi, Supervisor of the Xihe circuit and commander-in-chief of the five columns, urged an immediate attack on Wuzhu before Loushi could arrive, and had the dismissed Qu Duan set up in the ranks to make a show of strength, a ruse that Loushi saw through. Wu Jie proposed moving the army up to high ground to meet the Jin cavalry, but Liu Xi and the others declined, arguing that their numbers were superior and that the reed marsh in front would check the enemy horse, and the Song camp was therefore pitched beside low, wet ground. Zhao Zhe, who led the Huanqing circuit troops, was isolated by the end of the day and left the field without orders, and his command scattered. Wanyan Loushi, though he was ill, personally pressed his right wing forward and climbed a hill to read the Song dispositions, seeing through the weakness of the Song lines. Wanyan Zongfu directed the whole attack with Loushi on the right and Wuzhu on the left. The dashing commander Wanyan Zhehe opened the way with three thousand cavalry. Among the Song officers Han Chang was struck in one eye by a stray arrow yet fought on and broke out together with Wuzhu, while the Jin rider-commander Chilian Hui, whose cavalry sank into the mud, was cut down with great loss.
kits: 此役的核心兵器是弩。任務所列的十字弩是一件歐洲式弩機，年代定於一一〇〇年，其結構是弩把、弩機、弩弦與弩臂的組合：張弦上弦靠人力絞弦器或牛筋絞盤，扣機一放，弩矢依機括直線射出，射程遠、穿透力強，但裝填一次要花十數步。同一原理在宋軍中就是成建制的弩隊，《武經總要》所載神臂弓、臂弓、十字弩三等弓弩，以及守城用的床子弩、拒馬槊，都是這一類張弦發射的器械：神臂弓拉力大，矢能穿甲，射程可及二百餘步；十字弩以絞弩機張弦，陣地齊射時密度高而單發精準；床子弩架在木牀上，供城頭或陣前固定射擊，移動不便。宋軍野戰編制裡，弩手多列在長弓手之前，射畢即退入兩翼掩體，專以齊射壓制對方騎兵衝鋒前的密集隊形。金軍方面，女真騎兵以角弓為主，步卒以漢式弓弩、鎗刀、牌盾配搭，並備有大量箭袋與備用皮條。攻城裝備方面，宋軍備雲梯、撞車、飛石砲與穴地之法，金軍有拋石機、雲梯與長梯，攻城之前先用砲火壓制城頭守軍。須說明的是，《續資治通鑑》卷一百八記富平之戰，只詳戰陣與指揮，未細記弓弩的實際配置與耗彈；可以確定的只是，宋軍的弩裝備體系在西北防線上屬於標準配備，士卒也確實攜帶，但此役的成敗並不取決於弓弩射程。
kitsEn: The weapon at the centre of this campaign is the crossbow. The crossbow on this card is a European type, dated to 1100, built from a stock, a lock, a string and prod: the string is bent by a windlass or a sinew-wound ratchet, and once the trigger is released the bolt flies straight along the rail, carrying far and punching through armour, but each shot costs a dozen steps of loading. The same principle appears in Song China as crossbow units in their own right. The three grades of bow and crossbow set down in the Wujing Zongyao, the divine arm bow, the lesser arm bow and the crossbow, together with the bed crossbow and the refuse-pike used in defence of walls, are all of this tensioned-launch type: the divine arm bow had such a draw that its bolts could pierce armour out to more than two hundred paces, the crossbow was cocked with a ratchet and gave dense volleys with accurate single shots, and the bed crossbow stood on a wooden frame for fixed firing from a wall or a prepared position, and could not be moved. In Song field formations the crossbowmen were posted in front of the longbowmen, and once they had loosed they withdrew behind the flanks, using massed volleys to break up the dense order in which cavalry charged. On the Jin side the Jurchen horse carried composite horn bows, and their foot were equipped in the Chinese fashion with bows and crossbows, spear and dao, and shield, with ample arrow bags and spare bowstrings to hand. For siege work the Song had scaling ladders, battering rams, stone-throwers and mining, while the Jin brought stone-throwers, scaling ladders and long ladders, and opened an assault with artillery fire to silence the defenders on the walls. It should be said that the Xu Zizhi Tongjian in volume 108, which narrates Fuping, records the order of battle and the command problems in detail but says little about the actual posting of bows and crossbows or the arrows spent; what can be said with certainty is only that crossbow equipment formed part of the standard establishment of the Song army on the northwestern frontier and that the troops did carry it, even though the outcome of this battle was decided by something other than the reach of a crossbow.
tactics: 富平之戰是一場以糧道與騎兵機動決定勝負的會戰。宋軍自邠州、秦鳳一線北進，九月進抵富平，兩軍相距八十餘里，兀術屯於下邽。宋軍挑一處蘆葦叢生的沼澤作屏障扎營列陣，把營地擺在低窪地帶；各路運送輜重的鄉民在宋營外圍設小寨，這一圈小寨既是搬運點也是前哨，一旦被突破，鄉民便朝營內奔逃，直接衝擊本部的陣腳。張浚致書約戰，金軍堅壁不出，故意示弱驕敵以拖延時日，等完顏婁室自河東抵達；婁室登山觀陣，斷定宋軍雖多而壁壘不固，破綻甚多。九月二十四日，劉錫先遣千餘人作試探性攻擊，婁室設伏前後夾擊，幾乎全滅；到中午，完顏折合率三千騎用土囊在沼澤中墊出一條通道，越沼而進，直插宋營外圍的鄉民小寨，鄉民奔入宋營引起騷動；完顏宗輔隨即以婁室為右翼、兀術為左翼同時發動攻擊，宋軍倉促迎戰，五路兵馬各自為戰，統一指揮喪失。涇原路劉錡一度包圍兀術左軍，赤盞暉所部騎兵陷泥不能馳騁而被斬甚眾，兀術與韓常拼死破圍；婁室率右軍攻趙哲的環慶軍，蒲察胡盞、夾谷吾里補衝鋒陷陣，軍勢一度復振；趙哲孤軍不敵而擅自離陣，部眾爭相奔逃，黃昏金軍併力一擊，宋軍全線崩潰，退往邠州，輜重大多遺棄。補給線才是這一役真正的弱點：宋軍孤軍深入金境，糧秣靠預借民賦與民夫運轉，金軍以騎兵游騎不斷襲擾給養，又在富平周邊堅壁不動以拖時間，宋軍列陣日久，士卒飢疲，弩手與長弓手即使仍能齊射，也撐不住斷糧與崩潰。
tacticsEn: Fuping was a meeting engagement decided by supply lines and by cavalry manoeuvre. The Song army advanced north from the line of Binzhou and Qinfeng and reached Fuping in the ninth month, the two forces standing more than eighty li apart, with Wuzhu stationed at Xiaxian. The Song picked a stretch of marsh thick with reeds as a screen, pitched their camp in low ground, and set up small stockade villages around the camp where the porters who brought up baggage and supplies were billeted; these villages were both transfer points and outposts, and once one of them was penetrated the villagers would bolt into the camp and throw the formation of their own troops into confusion. Zhang Jun sent his letter of battle, and the Jin held their walls and came out to fight nobody, deliberately showing weakness to bait the Song and to gain time until Wanyan Loushi arrived from Hedong. Loushi climbed a hill, read the Song array and concluded that though the Song were many, their ramparts were unsound and full of openings. On the twenty-fourth day of the ninth month Liu Xi sent more than a thousand men in a probing attack, and Loushi ambushed them from both sides and destroyed them almost completely. By midday Wanyan Zhehe led three thousand cavalry, filled the marsh with sacks of earth to make a causeway, crossed the wet ground and struck straight at the villages around the Song camp, and the villagers rushing in set the camp in confusion. Wanyan Zongfu then launched the general attack with Loushi on the right wing and Wuzhu on the left, and the Song met it in disorder, each of the five columns fighting on its own with the unity of command already lost. Liu Qi of Jingyuan at one point surrounded Wuzhu's left wing, and the cavalry of Chilian Hui, mired in the mud and unable to gallop, were cut down in numbers, while Wuzhu and Han Chang fought their way out. Loushi led the right wing against Zhao Zhe's Huanqing circuit, where Pucha Huzhan and Jiagu Wulibu charged deep and steadied the Jin line for a moment; but Zhao Zhe, isolated, left the field without orders, and his men fled. At dusk the Jin struck with everything at once, the Song front collapsed, and the army withdrew towards Binzhou, leaving most of its baggage on the ground. The real weakness of this battle lay in the line of supply: the Song had marched deep into Jin territory, their grain resting on advances of the local revenue and on human carriers, while Jin horse patrols harried the baggage and the Jin stood still before Fuping to let time work on the Song army. The Song had stood in the field too long, the men were hungry and tired, and even if the crossbowmen and longbowmen could still loose, they could not hold against hunger and collapse.
data: 本役可引的數字多半出自《續資治通鑑》卷一百八與《宋史》相關傳記，彼此常有出入，只能作量級參考。張浚所集五路大軍，記為步、騎十八萬人，而號稱四十萬，兩說差距極大，後世多以十八萬為較可取的記載，號稱數則屬誇大。金方方面，兀術率二萬騎自洛陽西調，完顏婁室自河東率軍數萬，兩軍在富平合兵；九月二十四日投入突擊的兵力中，完顭折合所部為三千騎，先行試探的宋軍為千餘人。兩軍初抵富平時相距八十餘里。懸賞數字亦可作戰意對照：宋軍許擒完顏婁室者授節度使、賞銀絹各以萬計，金軍則許活捉張浚者賞驢一頭、布一匹。時間線是：七月金太宗定策，八月張浚發布攻金檄文，九月五路軍抵達富平，九月二十四日交戰，十月張浚以敗軍之罪處分將佐、退守秦州；至次年三月，金軍已攻取陝西五路大部，宋軍僅守住階州、成州、岷州、洮州、鳳州五州，以及鳳翔府和尚原、隴州方山原等隘口。有關富平之戰的雙方死傷總數，古今記載皆無可靠數字可引，諸說並存，本篇不另作估算。
dataEn: The numbers available for this battle come chiefly from volume 108 of the Xu Zizhi Tongjian and from the relevant biographies in the Song Shi; they often disagree with one another and can only be used to indicate scale. Zhang Jun's five columns are recorded as eighteen thousand foot and horse, though proclaimed as four hundred thousand, a very wide gap, and later writers mostly treat the figure of eighteen tens of thousands as the more credible, the proclaimed number being plain exaggeration. On the Jin side, Wuzhu brought twenty thousand cavalry from Luoyang and Wanyan Loushi led several tens of thousands down from Hedong, the two joining at Fuping. Of the troops committed in the assault of the twenty-fourth day of the ninth month, Wanyan Zhehe had three thousand cavalry, while the Song probe that went in first numbered a little over a thousand men. When the two armies first reached the neighbourhood of Fuping they were more than eighty li apart. The reward figures give a measure of the mood on both sides: the Song promised the rank of jiedushi and ten thousand each of silver and silk to whoever could take Wanyan Loushi, while Jin offered a donkey and a bolt of cloth to whoever could take Zhang Jun alive. The chronology runs: the seventh month, Jin Taizong settles on the plan; the eighth month, Zhang Jun issues his proclamation of war; the ninth month, the five columns reach Fuping; the twenty-fourth day of the ninth month, the battle; the tenth month, Zhang Jun punishes his commanders for the defeat and withdraws to Qinzhou. By the third month of the following year Jin had taken the greater part of the five circuits of Shaanxi, and the Song held only the prefectures of Jizhou, Chengzhou, Minzhou, Taozhou and Fengzhou, together with such passes as Heshangyuan in the prefecture of Fengxiang and Fangshanyuan in Longzhou. For the total casualties on both sides at Fuping no reliable figures survive in the records, accounts vary, and no estimate is offered here.
cause: 富平之戰的直接起因是金朝要把攻宋的重心西移。金太宗完顏晟在完顏宗弼渡長江攻宋受挫之後，聽取左副元帥完顏宗翰之謀，在中原扶植宋降臣劉豫建偽齊，令其接管淮東、淮西、京西三處戰場，作為南線的緩衝；但南宋在河東與陝東北端的防區仍緊貼金的側翼，故金廷決定以重兵先取陝西，並把完顏宗弼自六合召回洛陽，準備先下陝西、再入川東，迂迴滅宋。對宋方而言，張浚奉命在陝西發動攻勢，目的是牽制駐淮南的完顏昌，使金軍不能自東路南下；其主觀動機則是坐擁三川陝五路兵力、急於轉守為攻、爭取收復失地。張浚罷免曲端、拒納據險防守之策，又在吳玠、趙哲初戰收復長安、麟州、延州之後驕矜自大，才有了八月發布攻金檄文、九月傾師北進的舉動。戰前雙方在禮儀上的挑釁——宋送婦人之服、金懸賞捉張浚——顯示張浚判斷失誤：他以為金軍怯戰，卻不知金軍正藉此拖延，等的是婁室的河東主力。
causeEn: The immediate cause of the battle of Fuping was Jin's determination to shift the weight of its war against Song to the west. After Wanyan Zongbi's crossing of the Yangtze had been checked, Jin Taizong, Wanyan Sheng, took the advice of the left deputy commander Wanyan Zonghan and set up the state of Qi under the surrendered Song official Liu Yu in the Central Plains, giving Qi the three fronts of Huaidong, Huaixi and Jingxi as a buffer on the southern line. But the Song defences in Hedong and at the north-eastern end of Shaanxi still hugged Jin's flank, so the Jin court decided to seize Shaanxi with heavy forces first, recalled Wanyan Zongbi from Liuhe to Luoyang, and planned to take Shaanxi, turn into eastern Sichuan and encircle the Song from the rear. On the Song side Zhang Jun was ordered to open an offensive in Shaanxi in order to pin the Jin force in Huai-nan under Wanyan Chang and stop it marching south along the eastern road; his own motive was to hold the troops of the three circuits of Sichuan and Shaanxi, to turn defence into attack as quickly as possible and to recover the lost ground. Having dismissed Qu Duan and rejected the advice to hold the passes, and after Wu Jie and Zhao Zhe had in the opening moves recovered Chang'an, Linzhou and Yanzhou, Zhang Jun grew overconfident, and in the eighth month issued his proclamation of war and in the ninth month marched the whole host north. The challenges the two sides exchanged in the ritual of war, the Song sending women's clothing to the Jin and the Jin posting a reward for taking Zhang Jun, show where Zhang Jun's judgement failed: he believed the Jin were afraid to fight, when in truth they were stalling in order to wait for Loushi's main force from Hedong.
impact: 富平之敗是南宋西線的崩潰點。張浚退回秦州，陝西五路的經營自宣和末年以來第一次全盤失守，鳳翔、邠州、坊州、耀州等關中重鎮相繼淪入金軍之手；宋軍自關中平原退守隴右與關西南麓，只餘階、成、岷、洮、鳳五州與和尚原、方山原等幾處隘口憑險固守。此後吳玠、吳璘兄弟守和尚原，吳玠後來移鎮仙人關，在陝南屢挫金軍，一度斷了金軍由陝入蜀的通道；南宋由此長期以秦巴山脈與淮南兩道防禦線對抗金朝，直到隆興北伐與紹興和議的格局成形。人事上，張浚威信掃地，士論詆毀，一度罷樞密；趙哲、張忠、喬澤被斬，張中彥、李彥琪降金，慕容洮叛夏，環慶路與涇原路的將校系統為之一空，張浚經營川陝的班底不得不重建。對金朝而言，此役打通了入陝通道，使金軍得以在關中就地徵發糧秣、補充馬匹，也讓偽齊與南宋在淮西的對峙線趨於固定。此役更留下一個軍事教訓：以遠征的靜態野戰陣對抗以騎兵迂迴為主的機動作戰，而自身補給線暴露在敵騎之下，弩與弓再強亦無從發揮。
impactEn: The defeat at Fuping was the collapse point of the Song western front. Zhang Jun withdrew to Qinzhou, and the work of five circuits in Shaanxi was lost for the first time in a single blow since the end of the Xuanhe era; the strongholds of the Guanzhong plain, Fengxiang, Binzhou, Fangzhou and Yaozhou, fell away one after another into Jin hands, and the Song army fell back from the Guanzhong plain to Longyou and the southern slopes of Guanzhong, keeping only the five prefectures of Jizhou, Chengzhou, Minzhou, Taozhou and Fengzhou and a few passes such as Heshangyuan and Fangshanyuan. There Wu Jie and his brother Wu Lin held Heshangyuan, and Wu Jie later moved his command to Xianrenguan, repeatedly checked Jin armies in southern Shaanxi and for a time cut the road by which Jin might come from Shaanxi into Sichuan. From then on the Southern Song faced Jin along two defensive lines, the Qinling and Bashan ranges and the Huai river, until the shape of the Longxing northern expedition and the Shaoxing settlement settled the question. In personal terms Zhang Jun's authority was destroyed, the opinion of the scholar-officials turned against him and he was for a time removed from the Privy Council; Zhao Zhe, Zhang Zhong and Qiao Ze were beheaded, Zhang Zhongyan and Li Yanqi went over to Jin, Murong Tao fled to Western Xia, and the officer corps of the Huanqing and Jingyuan circuits was gutted, so that the structure Zhang Jun had built up in Sichuan and Shaanxi had to be made again. For Jin the battle opened the road into Shaanxi, allowed the army to draw grain and remounts on the spot in Guanzhong, and fixed the line of confrontation between the state of Qi and the Southern Song in the west of the Huai. The battle left a plain military lesson as well: a static field army on a long expedition cannot stand against mobile opponents whose strength is cavalry encirclement, and once the supply line lies open to the enemy horse, the bow and the crossbow, strong as they are, have nothing to give.
result: 結果是金軍完勝，宋軍大敗。完顏婁室的右軍與兀術的左軍在富平合擊，宋軍五路失去統一指揮，各自為戰，環慶路趙哲擅自離陣引發全線奔逃，黃昏宋軍崩潰，退往邠州，隨軍輜重大部分遺棄在陣地與沿途，成為金軍最豐厚的一批戰利品。十月，張浚回到秦州，以敗軍之罪論處：貶逐都統制劉錫，斬趙哲及其部將張忠、喬澤；涇原路將領張中彥、李彥琪投降金軍，環慶路將領慕容洮叛降西夏；張浚本人退守秦州，川陝方面的反攻宣告結束。宋軍此後由攻勢轉為守禦，在和尚原、方山原等地設防。金軍乘勝追擊，攻入關中，至次年三月已取陝西五路大部，僅容宋軍守住階州、成州、岷州、洮州、鳳州與鳳翔和尚原、隴州方山原等處，於是金朝對關中的控制建立起來，宋金在西北的疆界大致固定。富平之戰雖是一場敗仗，卻也逼出南宋後來更倚重防禦工事與山地要塞的取向；岳飛等將在兩淮與襄漢方向的另一輪北伐，與此役形成前後兩段不同的攻守。
resultEn: The result was a complete Jin victory and a Song defeat. The right wing of Wanyan Loushi and the left of Wuzhu closed on Fuping together; the five Song columns had lost the unity of command and fought each on its own; Zhao Zhe of Huanqing left the field without orders and the whole line fled; and at dusk the Song army broke and withdrew towards Binzhou, leaving the greater part of its baggage on the battlefield and along the road, the richest haul the Jin took from the fight. In the tenth month Zhang Jun reached Qinzhou and punished his officers for the defeat: Liu Xi, commander-in-chief, was demoted and driven out; Zhao Zhe and his generals Zhang Zhong and Qiao Ze were beheaded; the Jingyuan commanders Zhang Zhongyan and Li Yanqi surrendered to Jin, and Murong Tao of Huanqing defected to Western Xia. Zhang Jun himself stayed at Qinzhou, and the Song counter-offensive in Sichuan and Shaanxi was over. The Song army now changed from attack to defence, fortifying positions such as Heshangyuan and Fangshanyuan. Jin followed up its victory, entered Guanzhong and by the third month of the next year had taken the greater part of the five circuits of Shaanxi, leaving the Song only Jizhou, Chengzhou, Minzhou, Taozhou and Fengzhou and the passes of Heshangyuan and Fangshanyuan; Jin control of Guanzhong was thereby established and the frontier between Song and Jin in the north-west was broadly fixed. Although Fuping was a defeat, it forced the Southern Song afterwards to lean far more heavily on fortifications and mountain strongholds, and the later northern expeditions of Yue Fei and his colleagues in the region between the two Huai rivers and around Xiangyang and Hanzhong form a second chapter of attack and defence answering to this one.
